name: v18.13.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Hosts can distinguish safely paused agents from turns still draining with `Agent.isPaused` ([#17073](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17073) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Codex accounts whose spend cap is used up are no longer picked through credit overage or from usage cached before the upgrade ([#16973](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16973) by [@DusKing1](https://github.com/DusKing1))
- Fixed Codex capacity 429s (`turn_rate_limit_exceeded`, "Codex is at capacity") reporting "Try again in ~N min" from the plan's usage-window reset, which made retries wait hours instead of the response's Retry-After ([#17087](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17087) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added GPT-6.1 Terra: `openai/gpt-6.1-terra` ships bundled ($1/$5, $0.05 cached, >272K long-context tier, 1.05M window), and Codex-discovered `gpt-6.1-terra`/`-wm` get API-equivalent pricing, the 922K extended-context maximum, and routing to Plus-or-higher accounts.
- Added Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed support on Kimi Code (`k3.1-pro`, `k3.1-pro-highspeed`) and the Moonshot API (`kimi-k3.1-pro`, `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed`): official pricing ($2/$10 and $4/$20 per MTok), a 131K output cap, and K3's reasoning and wire contract ([#16901](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16901) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `tools.restrictedFolders`: every action on a listed folder (the folder and everything below it) asks for an explicit Approve/Deny in every approval mode, `yolo` included, and no remembered grant, session approval, or ACP "Always allow" covers it; recursive searches rooted above a restricted folder ask too, commands are matched by the directory they run in, and a `deny` policy still denies ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))
- `/pause` shows draining turns and running jobs across the main agent's subagent tree, without waiting on finished turns, safely parked agents, or suspended advisor reviews ([#17073](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17073) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).

### Changed

- Reduced redraws during background subagent progress while keeping elapsed previews and native checklists current ([#17131](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17131) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal), based on [#16647](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16647) by [@Komzpa](https://github.com/Komzpa)).
- Restoring a session with many subagents refreshes the running-subagent badge and lists once per burst instead of once per agent ([#16642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16642) by [@Komzpa](https://github.com/Komzpa))
- `ask` answers now name the option a note is on (`m: [X, Y] (note on Y: …)`, `User added note on Y: …`) ([#17126](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17126) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed advisors dropping their review and showing a rate-limit error when the provider returns a timed 429 such as Codex's `turn_rate_limit_exceeded`; the advisor now waits out the Retry-After (within `retry.maxDelayMs`) and retries like the main agent ([#17087](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17087) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed a hashline `PUT` being refused with "would hold one more copy of line N … than the range did" when its body restates the line next to the range, fills the range, and adds a new line equal to that neighbour (a second `@property` or `#[test]`, or a `break;` above a new `case`); it applies again, dropping only the restated line ([#17028](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17028))
- Fixed task subagents receiving `AGENTS.md` files, including the user-level `~/.omp/agent/AGENTS.md`, when the session has additional workspace roots (`--add-dir`, `/add-dir`, `workspace.additionalDirectories`)
- Fixed an `ask` note added right after picking an answer landing on the next question's answer, in Tern and the TUI; Note now goes to the answer just picked until the next question gets other input ([#17126](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17126) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- ANSI and TSP `/pause` screens show unsettled turns and jobs, hide settled counters, and preserve counts and resume controls on short terminals ([#17073](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17073) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Added `noteOption` to `ExtensionAskDialogResultItem` and `QuestionResult`: the label of the option an ask note is on (unset for a note on the custom answer) ([#17126](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17126) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Changed

- `StatusLineComponent.setRunningSubagents()` and `setSubagentTreeCost()` now report whether their state changed, allowing callers to skip redundant redraws ([#17131](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17131) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

### Fixed

- Fixed the ask dialog's Note (button or `n`) right after a pick moved to the next question annotating that question's highlighted row instead of the answer just picked ([#17126](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17126) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed the ask dialog's Next button reopening the custom-answer editor after Other was cancelled instead of moving on to the next question or Review tab

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added an optional `maxFractionDigits` to `formatNumber()` that caps decimals on values below 1,000 ([#16973](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16973) by [@DusKing1](https://github.com/DusKing1))


## What's Changed
* fix(ai): report Codex spend-cap credits for credit-billed workspace seats by @DusKing1 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16973
* fix(advisor): wait out timed Codex capacity 429s instead of dropping reviews by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17087
* feat: show live pause settlement status in TUI and Tern by @anatoli-tsinovoy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17073
* fix(ask): keep a note on the answer just picked and name the noted option by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17126
* perf(tui): coalesce running-subagent badge refreshes on registry bursts by @Komzpa in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16642
* perf(tui): skip redundant subagent redraws without stale previews by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17131
* feat(catalog): add Kimi K3.1 Pro pricing and K3 contract on Kimi Code and Moonshot by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16901


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.13.0...v18.13.1
